summary: Tested Manager perf fix (?group= server filter + lazy light-index), Assign Category workflow, and Klarna/PayPal Express pricing fixes. Backend 19/21 pytest pass. Tiles Manager now loads in ~6s with no freeze (1059 rows, 794 series; JS thread stays responsive), and only fetches ?limit=3000&group=tiles. Materials(137)/Flooring(3)/Bathroom(36)/UFH(75)/Tools(0) each load in ~4s with correctly scoped requests. Search, Quick Edit modal open/close (0.4s), checkbox→Bulk bar, cross-Manager carry-over, and the 'Selected' panel for not-loaded products (name + 'open in Tools Manager' route from light-index) all work. light-index only fires once a selection exists. Supplier Products > Assign Category > Tools returned 200, toast 'Assigned 1 product(s)', product showed up in Tools Manager (then reverted). Express: retail basket with 10% volume tier → cart £511.99 = Klarna & PayPal session total £511.99 (sent price 36.00 effective, delivery 79.99 from default_fee). BUT for TRADE users express now charges ex-VAT: cart shows £506.39 inc VAT, PayPal Express session total = £421.99 (VAT £84.40 missing). Also default_fee=0 falls back to £49.99 in express, and the materials group filter drops 1 product (case-sensitive main_category match).

critical.issue: Trade users get undercharged. getEffectivePrice(c, isTrade=true) returns the EX-VAT trade price, and the express endpoint charges subtotal + delivery with no VAT. Repro: trade.test login, 12 m² at £40 retail with tiers [10,20]/[0,10,20] and 5% trade discount → cart shows Total inc VAT £506.39, but the PayPal session total is £421.99 (sent price 28.5). The full £84.40 of VAT is missing. Fix: for trade users, send the inc-VAT price (effective*1.2) or add VAT on the server when the session belongs to a trade customer. Also make delivery match the cart's VAT handling.

minor.issue: `float(delivery_cfg.get('default_fee', 49.99) or 49.99)`: the `or 49.99` turns a configured default_fee of 0 (free delivery) into £49.99. The cart page accepts 0 (it checks `default_fee >= 0`), so the cart shows £0 and express charges £49.99. Confirmed by test_zero_default_fee_respected. `free_threshold ... or 500` has the same falsy problem. Use an explicit None check instead.

The express total leaves out the mandatory per-item delivery charge (itemDeliveryCharge, from delivery_charge_required items) and the congestion and parcel rules that the cart and guest-checkout apply, so baskets containing such items will still differ from the cart total.

main_category is matched with a case-sensitive `$in: ['materials']`/`['tiles']`/etc. The DB stores 'Materials'/'Tiles', but the frontend isMatch lowercases. Result: Canopy HE6000 (main_category='Materials', no product_group) showed in the Materials Manager before this change and is now missing. Use a case-insensitive regex such as ^materials$ with option i (same for tiles/flooring/bathroom).

Still existing (not new): the server trusts the client-sent `price` (the comment says 'never trust frontend'). Sending the effective price from the client makes this more important. Prices and tier discounts should be re-derived server-side from product_id.

integration_issues.issue: The displayed total (inc VAT) is not what gets charged (ex VAT). See the backend critical issue.

issues: The top banner and the free-delivery note say 'over £499' while free_threshold is 500 (cosmetic, and the copy is hardcoded).

action_items: HIGH: Fix the trade-user express undercharge. Include 20% VAT for trade baskets (send effective*1.2 or add VAT on the server) so the Stripe total equals the cart's total-inc-vat.
Replace the `or 49.99` / `or 500` fallbacks in both express endpoints with explicit None checks so default_fee=0 / free_threshold=0 are respected.
Make the main_category conditions in MANAGER_GROUP_FILTERS case-insensitive, so they are a true superset of the frontend isMatch (restores HE6000 in the Materials Manager).
Optional: add itemDeliveryCharge (mandatory per-item delivery) to the express total, or hide the express buttons when such items are in the basket.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/shop.py express endpoints: a falsy fallback (`x or default`) silently overrides admin-configured 0 values.
TileCartPage express handlers send ex-VAT prices for trade users, while the backend has no VAT logic, so totals are wrong for every trade express order.
supplier_sync MANAGER_GROUP_FILTERS: `$in` on main_category is case-sensitive, but the DB has mixed-case values ('Tiles', 'Materials', 'Wall Tiles').
light-index: products without sku/supplier_code get key 'supplier|||undefined' because _id is not returned; the frontend key falls back to _id, so those won't resolve (edge case).
Manager pages still render all 1059 rows at once (no virtualisation). Load is acceptable now (~6s, responsive), but this is worth watching as the catalogue grows.
The double fetch of /products?group= on each Manager page is caused by React.StrictMode in dev only (not a prod bug).
Custom Managers still fetch limit=3000 without a group filter, which will silently truncate once the catalogue exceeds 3000 products.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all Manager/bulk/assign flows pass; trade express total mismatch)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter254_manager_group_and_express_pricing.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. The tests toggle checkout_settings via direct Mongo and restore it. Express buttons are hidden on the live site because payments.klarna_enabled/paypal_enabled are off; they must be enabled temporarily to test the UI. To exercise the trade express check: log in via POST /api/shop/auth/login as trade.test@tilestation.co.uk, then set localStorage tile_shop_token, tile_shop_customer and tilestation_cart (an item with retail_price_inc_vat, tier_thresholds, tier_discounts, trade_discount), and compare [data-testid=total-inc-vat] with the create-session response total. Not verified this round: the Stripe-side line items via Session.retrieve (proxy).
rca of the issue: Trade VAT undercharge: cartPricing.getEffectivePrice strips VAT for trade (`priced/1.20`) for ex-VAT display. The cart adds VAT back separately (vatAmount), but the express payload uses only the per-item effective price, and shop.py express sums price*qty + delivery with no VAT step. Zero fee: `float(cfg.get('default_fee', 49.99) or 49.99)` treats 0 as falsy. Materials missing product: _build_group_or_filter uses `{'main_category': {'$in': ['materials']}}` against the stored value 'Materials'.
